productConcept.name: Solum
productConcept.description: A precision soil analysis platform for agronomists, environmental consultants, and research institutions — connecting field data capture, laboratory integration, and standards-compliant report generation in an unbroken audit chain.
productConcept.rationale: The Iron Vellum design system's warm off-white palette, Space Grotesk display type, and constrained typographic scale signal measured authority — the register of a scientific instrument, not a consumer product. The name Solum (Latin: soil, ground) maps directly to the system's material character. The product world of soil investigation sits entirely apart from the editorial/paper/publishing territory that other warm-palette systems have populated.
